# qualys_was_dns_overrides (Data Source)

Look up Qualys WAS DNS override records, for referencing a record managed
outside Terraform from `qualys_was_scan_schedule`'s `dns_override_id` or
`qualys_was_application`'s `dns_override_ids`/`default_dns_override_id`,
by name instead of a hardcoded ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_was_dns_overrides" "staging" {
  name_contains = "Staging"
}

output "staging_dns_override_id" {
  value = one([for o in data.qualys_was_dns_overrides.staging.dns_overrides : o.id])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource.
- **name_contains** (String) Filter results to records whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive). Applied client-side, after the API call.

### Read-Only

- **dns_overrides** (List of Object) Matching DNS override records, ordered by ID for stable output. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_overrides))
